description: Generated by scripts/gen_layer_fixtures.py (M3-T2a); the op contracts and the decisions behind the expectations are in tests/data/surface/layers/README.md. M3 layer analysis (findLayers) on oxides from the bulk prototypes: TiO2(110) ideal and with LEED-size displacements, ZnO(10-10) ideal and with the top Zn moved in (the displaced slabs at 0.3 and 0.5 Å), SrTiO3(001) both terminations, CeO2(111), NaCl(100), Al2O3(0001) at 0.3 and 0.6 Å, stoichiometric units (group "units", M3 §3.6) and bulk wurtzite along four-index directions.

cases.note: M3 §7.1: O_br 1.267 Å above Ti2O2, 0.715 Å between trilayers
